headline: DeepSeek still holds the top spot at 24.5% as four newcomers and four exits reshuffle the lower ranks
summary: DeepSeek keeps the crown with a 24.5% provider share, and the top two providers hold 35.8% between them. Further down, four models arrived and four dropped off, so the tail is getting busier.
highlights: DeepSeek and StepFun together hold 35.8% of tokens, the top two providers' combined share.
openai/gpt-oss-120b climbed eight places in a day to 35th, the biggest one-day climb on the board.
moonshotai/kimi-k3 moved up three spots to 13th.
New entrants: x-ai/grok-4.7 at 40th, qwen/qwen3.8-27b at 45th, meta/muse-wonder at 49th, and qwen/qwen3.7-flash at 51st.
Dropped off the board: meta/muse-spark-1.3 (last ranked 37th), perplexity/pplx-decider-v1.1-27b, qwen/qwen3.8-max, and mistralai/mistral-large-4-0.
